nguon: 💬 Giao tiếp · Bản thân & gia đình · bài tự soạn
L: A
Hi Dan! Are you settling into your new place?
B
It's great, but it feels a bit empty.
A
Give it time. We've lived here for six years.
B
Do you have kids? I saw a boy on a bike.
A
Yes, two. Ben is five and Ivy is nine months old.
B
Nine months! Does she sleep through the night?
A
Not really. We take turns getting up.
B
Do the kids share a room?
A
Not yet. Ben has the bunk bed, and Ivy still sleeps in our room.
B
It sounds cozy. Is there a yard?
A
A tiny one. Come by on Sunday and meet the kids.
B
I'd love to. Thanks for inviting me!

exq.q: How long has Nora lived in her home?
exq.why: “We've lived here for six years.” = sống ở đây sáu năm.
“Ivy is nine months old.” = Ivy chín tháng tuổi.
“Ivy still sleeps in our room.” = Ivy vẫn ngủ trong phòng bố mẹ.

exq.q: What does Nora invite Dan to do?
exq.a: Come by on Sunday and meet the kids
exq.why: “Come by on Sunday and meet the kids.” = ghé chơi chủ nhật và gặp bọn trẻ.
